entries.note: R3-6 (Opus N3-4): usable is now judged from the ink followed to the frame, not from where the first column sample landed. c1 (the 4 A steep branch, 17 points) has its ink running to the top frame (reviewer pixel dump az_rq6.txt: columns 364-368 reach y=52), exactly like its twin c0, which was already usable. No point moved; its readouts change from 'curve_not_usable' to 'not_in_extracted_trace' (the branch ends at 1.88 V, so 2.5/3.3/4.5 V lie past its traced end).
